payout_quote: The study involves one in-person visit at CU Boulder and will take approximately 90 minutes. Participants who complete all study procedures will receive $30 per hour in compensation.
steps: Open the CU Boulder Today article (2026-09-16) and find 'Study on chronic pain and reading'
Confirm eligibility: at least 18, able to come to CU Boulder in person, and have chronic pain
Fill out the screening questionnaire (linked in the article) or email painlab@colorado.edu
Complete the one in-person visit (~90 minutes): reading/comprehension task with eye tracking plus background/health questionnaires
Receive $30 per hour for completing all study procedures
catches: Eligibility requires having chronic pain — the study is about how adults with chronic pain read informational texts
Single in-person visit at CU Boulder; pay is $30/hr for ~90 minutes (about $45)
Eye tracking is non-invasive but involves recorded gaze data
biggest_catch: Eligibility requires chronic pain; pay is $30/hour for a single ~90-minute in-person visit (about $45 total).
eligibility: At least 18 years old, able to come to CU Boulder for an in-person visit, and have chronic pain.
timing: One in-person visit, approximately 90 minutes; payment timing/form not stated beyond completing all procedures.
